title: Cultural Prompting Improves the Empathy and Cultural Responsiveness of GPT-Generated Therapy Responses
reasoning: The study focuses on the cultural responsiveness and empathy of LLM-generated therapy responses for Chinese American family caregivers. While it evaluates the model's ability to incorporate cultural values such as 'filial piety' (a moral/ethical concept in many Asian cultures), the primary objective is clinical/cultural alignment rather than a specific evaluation or benchmarking of religion, faith, or general ethical/moral systems.
